verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-payable API: it accepts MPP payments without signup. A buyer could therefore fairly ask whether it is listed in, or publishes, a directory where agents discover payable services, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows such a listing or directory. The llms.txt file, MCP server and UCP catalog cover Channel3's own docs and its product search, not discovery of payable services or APIs, and the MPP payment ability is a separate story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can discover payable services and APIs through a published directory or discovery index
